scenario: An investigative journalist researching a viral political claim catalogs a set of primary sources with the source-library skill, runs fact-checking on the central claim with verify-claims, and finally generates a publishable story brief with the reporting skill.
info_flow: source-library ingests URLs provided by the journalist and records structured metadata (claims, confidence signals, tags) for each source → verify-claims uses that cataloged source set as its corroboration base when checking the central claim → reporting synthesizes the fact-check result and source summaries into a journalist-facing story brief.
